title: What Joe wanted from the clarinet; not reading music
summary: Joe wanted to get out of Baton Rouge and liked the sound; he disliked reading, and the medicine and circus side-show bands needed none.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: What did you seem to get from the clarinet? What was the main purpose for you in the early days? What did you sort of want to get from it?
I wanted a way to get out of Baton Rouge, for one thing, and I wanted to get on a circus -- because my uncle told me that.
I don't mean from the physical point of view. I mean just as an ....(?)...

I liked the sound of the clarinet. I used to like to pick up my clarinet every day, pick it up and try to play something. I never liked to read. I always wanted to play what was in my mind. I guess if it was left to me, I probably wouldn't have never learned how to read. But when I got off the medicine show, and during the circus...I didn't have to read any music on the circus to start with either, because I was working in the side show band -- so you didn't have any music.
